On Linux, CAS can already be injected into Godot thanks to [vkBasalt](https://github.com/DadSchoorse/vkBasalt). Other programs such as ReShade may also be able to do this on other platforms.

However, injection-based approaches will often apply sharpening to 2D elements, making the editor and GUI elements appear unnecessarily sharp. A proper CAS implementation in Godot will make it possible to sharpen only 3D elements.

title: Integrate contrast-adaptive sharpening (CAS) in the Vulkan renderer
